dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Those savages? There's nothing to be said for those detestable invaders! They destroy our cities, slaughter our people...

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Enemies of the empire I name them... Nay, enemies of all civilization!

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Still, you need not fear, citizen! Dominus Boethius shall soon come to Machimos in person.

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: When that happens, all disturbances shall be utterly quelled, and those putrid primitives shall get what they deserve!
